LanguageData.RR_Generation_InvalidRoomGraph: The saved room plan is invalid; the site remains closed and its recorded layout was kept.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_OwnerMismatch: The saved coordinate belongs to a different or invalid site owner. No replacement map was made.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_OwnerMissing: The saved site owner is missing. The coordinate was kept for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_OwnerDefMissing: The destination owner definition is unavailable.

LanguageData.RR_Generation_OwnerRegistrationFailed: The destination owner could not be saved in the world. The coordinate plan was kept.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_PreviouslyOpenedMapMissing: The previously opened site map is missing. Its coordinate was kept and not rerolled.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_MapSizeOrOwnerMismatch: The saved site map has the wrong size or owner.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_IncompleteLayout: The site map did not produce its complete saved layout.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_UnreachableRequiredCell: A required room, evidence space, entry, or return cell is unreachable. The gate remains closed.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_MapBuildFailed: The site could not be prepared. The coordinate and any generated map were retained for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_MapOwnerOrGraphMismatch: The destination generator did not find its matching saved coordinate and room graph.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_RefusedToReplaceSavedLayou: The generator refused to replace an already saved room layout.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_RequiredCoreOrSiteDefMissi: A required Core or Rimrooms site definition is missing.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_NonAdjacentRooms: The saved room graph contains a disconnected physical link.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_CorridorOutOfBounds: A generated corridor fell outside the finite site map.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_WallOutOfBounds: A generated wall fell outside the finite site map.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_WallOverlap: Generated site walls overlap a room feature.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_NoReturnAnchorCell: The threshold has no safe space for its return anchor.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_InvalidFixtureDef: The destination fixture definition is not a building.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_NoSafeRoomCell: No clear, walkable placement cell remains in the required room.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_NoReturnCell: The return anchor has no safe adjacent return cell.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_InvalidStartOrObjectiveCel: The generated entry, return point, or evidence space is unsafe.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_UnreachableRoom: The generated room graph is not physically reachable from the entry.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_FluorescentDescription: An original, damaged fluorescent fixture. It emits light without drawing from the crew's power grid, but it can be broken.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ClimateUnitDescription: An original passive unit that warms its sealed room up to 20°C. It draws no site power, cannot cool a hot room, and can be damaged.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_NoSafeCandidate: No safe first-site layout was found within the bounded attempt limit.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ContentAlreadyStarted: Room contents were already started; the saved partial site is retained.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_InvalidSalvageDef: A salvage item cannot be safely packed with the installed definitions.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ContentPlacementFailed: Room content placement stopped; the existing site is retained.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_InvalidDoorDef: The installed doorway definition cannot provide the required native room access.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_GateAccessOnly: Enter this coordinate through the machine gate.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_threshold_room: Two waiting stools face a route that has no ordinary exterior. Use the return anchor for extraction; reaching this room alone does not send cargo home.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_survey_lobby: A table and chair mark the first survey station. Compare the saved coordinate and surveyed-room count in Operations before leaving this junction. Gate Telemetry later adds the recorded room connections.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_office_copy: Two workstations repeat the same arrangement. The physical route recording is stored separately in this room; pick it up and carry it back for analysis.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_service_passage: A shelf and disconnected standing lamp mark this passage. Place a numbered survey tag at a verified junction before proceeding into the Borrowed Corridor.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_borrowed_corridor: The paired planters offer a familiar shape without a reliable direction. Compare the real numbered tag and return beacon with their recorded rooms when the route changes.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_storage_nook: This loose salvage is a physical cargo item. Taking it uses actual crew capacity; it is never credited or returned remotely.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_utility_room: A standing lamp has no supplied power although the ceiling fixture still glows. This dead end provides an observation.
LanguageData.RR_Clue_Text_return_gallery: Paired stools mark the gallery on the saved return route. Keep the gate window and route markers in view; use a closed door deliberately when breaking pursuit.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ReaddressContentRestore: This failure needs package or source diagnosis. A replacement cannot repair this record; the saved site is retained for recovery.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ReaddressFailureNotEligibl: This coordinate is not an eligible failed first-survey site. Its current map and records remain unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ReaddressSiteNotPristine: The site already has activity, evidence, people or linked expedition records. It cannot be replaced; preserve the coordinate and recover its existing state.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ReaddressReplacementExists: A replacement record already exists with different survey links. Preserve both records and diagnose their ownership before proceeding.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ReaddressSiteCapReached: The first-survey recovery limit has been reached. One failed site and one replacement are retained; no third site will be generated.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_ReaddressFallbackInvalid: The bounded replacement layout did not pass its preflight. No survey links or items were changed.
LanguageData.RR_UI_FailedSiteRecoveryExplanation: If initial room placement failed before any visit or evidence creation, one replacement may be prepared. The failed map is retained. Sites with activity or package/source faults require diagnosis instead.
LanguageData.RR_UI_FailedSiteRecoveryConfirm: Prepare AI-01R for this unresolved initial survey?\n\nThe failed coordinate and every object on it remain saved. Only a pristine survey's contract and case may move to the new coordinate. Its six-room fallback is generated on dispatch. This permits one replacement only, spends no company money, and grants no items. Eligibility is checked again when confirmed.
LanguageData.RR_Event_SiteReaddressed: The unvisited failed survey at {0} was reassigned to {1}. The failed map is retained, and the original contract remains unpaid.
LanguageData.RR_Generation_Failed: This space could not be laid out. Nothing was generated and the coordinate is unchanged.
